summary: A near-complete, honest Phase 3 system. I installed, ran the suite (28 files / 249 tests pass in 74s), typechecked, linted and built the artifact, then exercised the built app in Chromium with an AudioNode.prototype.connect tap so every claim below is backed by measured signal or observed panel state. Organ (7 model steps with centroids 320-2120 Hz and high-band 0-0.098, nine live drawbars, percussion, vibrato/chorus, B3 key click at organ.ts:230, rotary), Synth (Pure/Sync/Multi/Super/FM-H families with high-band 0.1504/0.2514/0.0012, four filters, envelopes, three LFO destinations with 300-685 Hz centroid spread, voice modes, glide/unison, arp that keeps running on Hold after release at rms 0.0554) and the Program section (32 slots over 4 pages, dial browse, list view, Store/Store As with dial naming, dirty 'E' flag, discard+Undo, 8 auto-storing Live slots) all behave canonically, and splits/zones/scenes/morphs/clock/transpose/Panic integrate as one system: with piano A restricted to zone 2 the split at C4 gates keys 48/55/59 to exactly 0.0 while xfade Off/±6/±12 produces a measurably widening fade band (0/0/0 vs 0/0.00061/0.00196/0.00579 vs 0.00161/0.00214/0.00251/0.00650 at keys 50/55/58/59). Everything routes through one AudioContext with exactly one connection to the destination. Two real gaps keep it off top marks: program/Live persistence is claimed but not wired (localStorage stays empty across reload because App.tsx:64 never injects the exported localProgramStorage), and the panel's horizontal section fractions match the visual spec's superseded coarse values rather than the corrected ones (piano 0.146 vs 0.085, program 0.087 vs 0.125, synth 0.204 vs 0.25). Nothing fakes success: the nine spec-excluded controls press and do nothing, and the missing-sample path says 'FALLBACK voice active (synthesized, not the recorded library)'.

criteria.label: Reference and regression retention
evidence: Vertical allocation is exact: measured deck 0.540 and keys 0.460 of chassis height at 1440x900 (data-testid chassis/deck-block/keys-block), matching verticalAllocation 0.54/0.46 in inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.visual.json within tolerance.

Keybed matches the assigned Stage 4 73 variant: 73 key elements (document.querySelectorAll('[data-control-id^="key-"]') = 73), lowest key aria-label 'E1 key', so E1-E7 as in inputs/reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg.

Section order and landmarks match the reference: performance, organ, piano, program, synth, effects left-to-right with only two OLED displays (data-testid oled-program and oled-synth); no invented wide display over the piano or organ.

Deviation: measured horizontal fractions (performance 0.126, organ 0.204, piano 0.146, program 0.087, synth 0.204, effects 0.204) match the coarse values the spec explicitly retired ('the previous coarse values (piano 0.15, program 0.09, synth 0.21) contradicted the photo', horizontalSectionsNote) rather than the corrected piano 0.085 / program 0.125 / synth 0.25. Piano is ~1.7x too wide and synth ~0.8x too narrow relative to the current spec.

Responsive drift: at a 600px-wide viewport the chassis scales down as one unit, so legends and knob captions in the synth and effects columns render below ~5px and are no longer legible, while geometry and control inventory stay intact.

criteria.label: Complete hardware state fidelity
evidence: 225 elements carry data-control-id; all 225 have a non-empty aria-label, 50 expose role=slider with aria-valuemin/max/now, and 106 latching buttons expose aria-pressed, so every knob, drawbar, fader and toggle publishes its hardware value (measured by DOM audit in the built app).

The program OLED shows seven live lines and tracks state as I edited: '1.1 E | Royal Grand | ♪120 · Transp off · Split C4 · Scene I | ▤ A: Salamander Grand | 〜 Piano · Organ · Synth · FX ready | Split mid xfade ±12'. The performance line updated to '♪136' after tap tempo, 'Transp on +3' after transpose, 'Split F5' while stepping the split point and 'Scene II' after scene swap.

LED state is real, not painted: data-testid zone-leds-organA/pianoA/synthA reflect KB ZONE stepping ('Piano A zones 2–2' feedback), split-led-strip marks active split positions, and section on/off LEDs follow organ-on/piano-on/synth-on aria-pressed.

Focus and routing are visible: FX Focus cycling reports 'FX Focus Piano B' and Amp Sim/EQ routing reports 'Amp Sim/EQ: To Rotary'; engine-status, midi-status and pedal-status strips show 'Pedals: sustain up (Space / CC64 half-pedal) · sostenuto up …'.

Minor gap: while a morph drives a destination the knob keeps showing its stored value (piano-level-a aria-valuenow stayed '100' while the assigned Ctrl Ped morph pulled the audible level to silence), so morph movement is audible and reported in the edit line but not mirrored on the control itself.

criteria.label: Programs and Live Mode
evidence: 32 slots addressed as 8 buttons x 4 pages: page-right stepped 'Page 2' → 'Page 3' → 'Page 4' and program-1..8 select within a page; the dial browses continuously ('1.2 Tine Stack', '1.3 Gospel B3', '1.4 Continental', '1.5 Cathedral Pipe', '1.6 Super Lead', '1.7 FM Keys').
List view works and is reversible: prog-view opens 'LIST 1.1 Royal Grand' with a 'List: 1.1 Royal Grand' line and closes with 'List view closed'.

Store and Store As are canonical: I stored to slot 3 ('Stored 1.3 Royal Grand'), and Store As let me type a name with the dial (stored name 'Lpit' at 4.1). Editing a stored program raises the dirty flag ('1.1 E'), and browsing away reports '1.2 Tine Stack (edits discarded — Undo available)' with Undo restoring the edit.

Recall restores state: after storing, changing piano A level and recalling, the fader returned to its stored value (level 96 in the artifact's own scripted check, and I saw piano-level-a snap back to the stored value in the UI).
Live Mode auto-stores in session: live-mode switches the display to 'LIVE L1 | Live Init', and edits are kept without an explicit Store.

Gap against inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.programs.json ('Live slots persist edits automatically and survive reload'): after setting Live L1 piano A level to 60 and reloading, the app came back at '1.1 Royal Grand' with level 100 and Live Mode off, and Object.keys(localStorage) was [] both before and after reload. artifact/src/state/instrument.ts:591 exports localProgramStorage but nothing in src references it — artifact/src/App.tsx:64 constructs 'new InstrumentStore()' with no storage boundary.

criteria.label: Layers, splits, scenes, and morphs
evidence: Splits are editable, not fixed: split-onset toggles 'Split On' with the status line showing 'Split C4'; Shift+split-onset opens 'Split edit: dial = position, ◂▸ = point, Split = xfade'; the dial stepped the point C4 → F4 → C5 → F5 (status line following), ◂▸ cycled 'Split edit: high / low / mid' (the three editable points), and split-onset cycled 'Split mid xfade ±6 / ±12 / Off' matching crossfadeWidthsSemitones [0,6,12].

Crossfades are audible and width-correct. With piano A limited to 'Piano A zones 2–2' and the split at C4, measured rms at keys 50/55/58/59 (below the point) was 0/0/0/0 at xfade Off, 0/0.00061/0.00196/0.00579 at ±6, and 0.00161/0.00214/0.00251/0.00650 at ±12 — a fade band that widens exactly as the spec describes, while key 61 above the point stayed at 0.0134.

Zones: the KB ZONE ◂/▸ buttons step the focused layer's range with feedback ('Piano A zones 2–2', '2–3', '2–4', '3–3', '1–4') and gate audio — in zone 2–2 keys 48/55/59 measured exactly 0.0 while 61/66/72 measured 0.0133/0.0152/0.0063.

Scenes: the scene button swaps two independent layer sets ('Scene I' / 'Scene II' in the performance line) and changes enablement (scene II with organ B off, scene I with organ B on, confirmed by the artifact's scripted check 'II B=false I B=true' which I reran).

Morphs both ways: Wheel morph assign/interpolate/clear (assignments=[{kind:'drawbar',layer:'A',index:8}], high-band 0.0000 → 0.2498, cleared to 0 assignments), and Control Pedal morph assigned 'Morph level:pianoA: 100 → 0' then interpolated continuously with pedal 0/16/127 giving rms 0.00942/0.00697/0.00000; Shift+Ctrl Ped reported 'Ctrl Ped morphs cleared' and restored 0.00925 at full pedal.

Clock, transpose and Panic: two taps on mstclk-tap set '♪136'; transpose reported 'on=true semitones=3' and pitched playback accordingly; Panic silenced everything (rms 0.0000) with 'PANIC — all notes off'.

Minor nit: KB ZONE stepping allows ranges beyond the currently active split points (e.g. 'zones 2–4' with only the mid point active), which leaves the layer silent with no indication that the range is unreachable.

criteria.label: Complete Organ system
evidence: Two independent layers sharing one chain: organ A alone measured rms 0.0702, A+B together 0.1241 with spectral cosine 0.919 against A, and organ-layer-b/organ-level-b edit B's own model and drawbars ('Organ B On').

Seven model steps produce distinct spectra from the same C4: centroid 2120 / 320 / 300 / 372 / 1832 / 515 Hz with 2-8 kHz band ratios 0.0983 / 0 / 0 / 0 / 0.0816 / 0.0166 — tonewheel, Vox, Farfisa and Pipe families are audibly different engines, not renamed oscillators.
Nine drawbars are live and additive: pulling the high drawbars moved the 2-8 kHz band ratio from 0.0000 to 0.2495 on a held note, and each drawbar exposes role=slider with 0-8 values.

Percussion and vibrato/chorus are real and measurable (organ-perc-on/volume/decay/harmonic and organ-vib-on/organ-vib-select changed the rendered attack and modulation; the artifact's rerun check reports 'perc=true vibrato=true'), and the implementation matches the spec's tonewheel model with foldback (artifact/src/audio/organ.ts).

Key click follows the spec's 'fixed level' definition rather than being a fake control: artifact/src/audio/organ.ts:230 adds a 12 ms highpass-2200 Hz noise burst at peak 0.05 only for B3/B3 Bass, plus a registration-scaled Pipe chiff — there is correctly no user-facing key-click knob.
Rotary integration: with Amp Sim/EQ routed 'To Rotary' the organ signal showed amplitude fluctuation 3.25 at rms 0.4540, and rotary-speed/rotary-stop-mode/rotary-drive/rotary-morph all alter it.

criteria.label: Complete Synth system
evidence: Three layers exist and are separately focusable (synth-layer-a/b/c control ids), each with its own oscillator, filter, envelope, LFO and arp state.

All five required waveform categories are distinct: high-band ratios Pure 0.1504, Super 0.2514, FM-H 0.0012 (spread 207x) on the same note, with Sync and Multi in between; Osc Ctrl is category-correct (it sweeps sync ratio on Sync, detune spread on Super, and operator ratio/index on FM-H, audible as centroid shifts rather than a shared generic parameter).
Four filter types behave correctly: LP12/LP24 darken (2-8 kHz band 0.2233 → 0.0000 as filter-freq drops), HP removes lows, BP narrows; resonance and drive changed peak/harmonic content measurably.
Envelopes: raising amp attack delayed the measured onset (attack ramp visible in offline renders in artifact/src/audio/render-stage3.test.ts), and filter/mod envelopes shape the sweep.

LFO reaches three destinations with measurable modulation depth: Osc Pitch (rms spread 0.0512, centroid spread 300 Hz), Osc Ctrl (0.0512 / 375 Hz) and Filter Freq (0.0406 / 685 Hz) against a static baseline of rms 0.0172 / centroid 629 Hz; the destination cycles via Shift on lfo-waveform.

Voice modes, glide and unison all change behavior: poly holds chords, mono retriggers, legato glides without retrigger, glide time stretches the pitch ramp, unison thickens (rms and detune spread rise).

Arpeggiator is real and deterministic: it runs at the set rate, respects range and direction, gate shortens notes, and Hold keeps it running after key release (rms 0.0554 measured after releasing the keys); rate also follows the master clock when Shift-synced.

criteria.label: Distinct engine behavior
evidence: Organ models: measured centroid range 300-2120 Hz with high-band ratios 0-0.098 across the seven model steps on an identical note, i.e. tonewheel additive (nine partials with foldback, artifact/src/audio/organ.ts) versus Vox/Farfisa reed shaping versus Pipe chiff.

Synth families: high-band 0.1504 (Pure) / 0.2514 (Super) / 0.0012 (FM-H) from one note and one filter setting, with FM built as an operator stack and Super as detuned stacks in artifact/src/audio/synth.ts.

Piano types remain spectrally separate (Salamander Grand, Tack Upright, Tine EP measured at centroids 39.5 / 41.0 / 30.4 in the artifact's own metric, spread 1.35) and the recorded library is used where declared in artifact/IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json.

Cross-engine comparison confirms the three sections are not one shared voice: organ A+B against synth Pure on the same note gave spectral cosine well below 0.92, and offline renders in artifact/src/audio/render-stage3.test.ts assert per-engine spectra rather than mocks.

criteria.label: Inherited graph and effects integration
evidence: One context, one output: with a tap wrapping AudioNode.prototype.connect from page load, __tapState reported ctxs=1 and destConnects=1 after playing notes across piano, organ and synth — a single AudioContext with exactly one connection to AudioDestinationNode.

All engines feed the inherited per-layer buses and the six effect chains: FX focus cycling ('FX Focus Piano B') retargets the same units, and each unit measurably changes organ and synth output as well as piano (Mod1 fluctuation 11.96 vs 6.21 baseline, Mod2 wet 0.0033, delay repeat tail 0.0017, amp drive 0.0633, compressor 0.0608, reverb tail mean 0.00012 vs 0.00000 dry).
Rotary is shared, source-routed hardware: 'Amp Sim/EQ: To Rotary' put the organ through it (rms 0.4540, fluctuation 3.25) and the same routing is available to other sections.

Global path behaves: All FX Off bypasses every unit (effects-on aria-pressed=false while bypassed) with click-free crossfades (artifact/src/audio/effects.ts:26 and the assertions in artifact/src/audio/effects-routing.test.ts), master level scales the single output to near silence (rms 0.0002 muted), and Panic drops the bus to 0.0000.
Gain staging is sane across layering: single piano layer 0.0025 → layered 0.0038 → organ A+B 0.1241, without any layer bypassing the chain.

criteria.label: Musical quality, latency, and load
evidence: Layered and split play stays musical: piano+organ+synth together with a split at C4 and a ±12 crossfade produced smooth zone transitions with no zipper noise or dropouts across repeated probes.
Voice cleanup is clean: after rapid note bursts the active-voice count returned to 0 and the settled bus measured 0.00000; Panic gives 0.0000 immediately.
Arp timing is steady and clock-linked (tap tempo '♪136' then Shift-synced arp rate; the arp continued at a constant period under Hold, rms 0.0554).

Headroom is marginal under dense layering: measured peak 1.038 on a layered chord with drive and unison engaged, i.e. slightly past full scale, so hard-clipping is reachable without touching Master Level.

One of the artifact's own inherited browser checks was threshold-fragile in my environment: scripts/verify-browser.mjs reported 25/26 with 'rapid-notes-cleanup: peak=0.0005 settled=0.00000 voices=0' — the cleanup itself passed, the loudness precondition did not, so the check is sensitive to the sample-load path rather than showing stuck voices.
Latency is acceptable for pointer/keyboard play: notes were audible within the first ~130 ms settle window of every measurement, and the engine reports 'ready' before input.

criteria.label: Canonical state round-trip
evidence: In-session round-trip is real and broad: storing a program, editing, then recalling restored the changed value (piano A level back to its stored 96), and the serializer covers piano, organ, synth, all six chains, routing, splits, zones, scenes, morphs, clock and transpose (artifact/src/state/instrument.ts serialize/patch plus assertions in artifact/src/state/programs.test.ts).
Morph assignments survive the round-trip: assignments=[{kind:'drawbar',layer:'A',index:8}] were restored with the program and cleared only on explicit clear.
Split state round-trips with position and crossfade (recalling a program restored 'Split C4' and the stored xfade width in the edit line).
Displays follow restored state: after recall the OLED dropped the 'E' dirty marker and re-rendered slot, name, split, scene, clock and piano lines.

Gap: no persistence across reload. localStorage stayed empty ([] keys) before and after reload, Live L1 edits (level 60) were lost and the app reset to '1.1 Royal Grand' at level 100, because artifact/src/App.tsx:64 constructs InstrumentStore without the exported localProgramStorage boundary (artifact/src/state/instrument.ts:591, referenced nowhere else in src).

criteria.label: Required hardware bindings
evidence: Every non-excluded control I exercised produced a canonical state change plus display feedback — I drove drawbars, percussion, vibrato, organ model/octave, synth waveform/osc-ctrl/filters/envelopes/LFO/voice modes/glide/unison/arp, all six effect units and their focus/routing, levels, split/zone/scene/morph/clock/transpose/Panic, and each reported a specific edit-line message and audible change.

Coverage is enforced in the artifact: artifact/src/state/bindings-audit.test.ts enumerates the hardware model and asserts every non-decorative control mutates canonical state, and artifact/src/model/hardware.test.ts pins the control inventory.

The unsupported set is exactly the spec-excluded set (9 ids in artifact/src/model/hardware.ts:58-68: morph-at, preset-organ/piano/synth, organ-preset, section-edit, layer-init, mon-copy, synth-mode) and matches the excluded lists in inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.{programs,organ,synth}.json (aftertouch morph, preset libraries, Section Edit / Layer Init / Monitor-Copy, Extern/Samples modes). It is declared in artifact/IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json:72.

I clicked all nine excluded controls in the built app: none changed state and none printed a success message (edit line stayed '1.1 Royal Grand'), and Shift+program-N (the excluded System/Sound/Organize menus) is likewise inert — no generic no-op fallback masquerading as behavior.
Controls are keyboard-operable hardware, not decoration: 50 sliders respond to Arrow/Home/End/PageUp with aria-valuenow updates, and 106 latching buttons expose aria-pressed.

criteria.label: Cross-system workflows
evidence: I ran a full cross-system pass in one session: split at C4 with piano A confined to zone 2, organ A+B on with a Pipe model in the lower zone, synth arp held on top, effects focused per section, tempo tapped to 136 and transpose +3 — all simultaneously audible and consistent with every display line.
Scene swap flips whole layer sets while keeping the shared chain: 'Scene II' disabled organ B (B=false) and 'Scene I' re-enabled it (B=true), audible as rms 0.0702 → 0.1241.

Morph interacts with the rest of the system rather than a private value: the Ctrl Ped morph on piano A level attenuated the layer to silence while split gating and effects stayed in effect (rms 0.00942 → 0.00000 across the pedal sweep).

Focus is one concept across sections: layer buttons set the focused layer for KB ZONE, octave shift and FX focus, and the edit line names the target ('Piano B Octave +1', 'FX Focus Piano B', 'Piano A zones 2–2').

Programs capture the composed system: storing while split/scene/morph/transpose/clock were active and recalling restored them together, and the artifact's stage-3 browser script (21/21 in my run) asserts the same combinations end-to-end.

criteria.label: Inherited regression reliability
evidence: Phase 1/2 surface and behavior still work: 73 playable keys, three piano types measurably distinct, layer B adds signal (0.0025 → 0.0038), layer levels mute, octave shift reports 'Piano B Octave +1', and all six effect units plus All FX Off behave (rerun of artifact/scripts/verify-browser.mjs, 25/26).

Inputs are intact: sustain pedal sustains and damps (0.0038 → 0.0000), and half-pedal/soft/sostenuto paths report {half:0.5, soft:true, sostenuto:true} with a live pedal status strip; MIDI handling (CC64/66/67, denial, disconnect) is covered by artifact/src/input/midi.test.ts.

Honest failure paths are preserved: an unavailable piano type shows 'Piano not found (Clav)' with rms 0.0000, and a sample-load failure shows 'Piano: FALLBACK voice active (synthesized, not the recorded library)' while still sounding (rms 0.0131).
Console stays clean on load and through the whole exercise (no errors reported by either browser script or by my own session), and audio cleanup returns voices to 0.

Regressions to note: the single inherited check that failed in my environment was the loudness precondition of 'rapid-notes-cleanup' (peak=0.0005), and narrow viewports (~600px) shrink panel legends below legibility, so the responsive story is scale-only rather than adaptive.

criteria.label: System architecture
evidence: Canonical state has one owner: artifact/src/state/instrument.ts holds the whole instrument (programs, zones, split, scenes, morphs, clock, transpose) with patch/serialize and program storage as a typed boundary; artifact/src/state/presentation.ts is the only place that maps control ids to store actions, which keeps the UI free of engine knowledge.

Audio is one graph with injectable boundaries: artifact/src/audio/boundaries.ts injects audio/timer/asset/MIDI, artifact/src/audio/effects.ts composes the six chains, and voice construction is split into artifact/src/audio/organ.ts and artifact/src/audio/synth.ts; the running app uses a single AudioContext with one destination connection (measured destConnects=1).

Hardware inventory is modeled, not hardcoded per component: artifact/src/model/hardware.ts declares every control with type/range/section and marks decorative ones from UNSUPPORTED_CONTROL_IDS, so the panel and the bindings audit share one source of truth.

Weakness: artifact/src/audio/engine.ts is 1898 lines and still owns piano/organ/synth voice orchestration, pedals, arpeggiator, morphs and split gain in one file, and artifact/src/state/instrument.ts is comparably large — both are navigable but unwieldy for further extension.

Weakness: the persistence seam is dead code in the shipped app — localProgramStorage (artifact/src/state/instrument.ts:591) is exported and tested but never wired at the composition root (artifact/src/App.tsx:64), so a documented capability exists only in tests.

criteria.label: Tests and maintainability
evidence: The suite is substantial and green: 'pnpm test' ran 28 files / 249 tests in 74s with no failures, on Node 24.19.0 after 'pnpm install'; 'tsc --noEmit' and oxlint are clean and 'pnpm build' produced dist/index.html.

Audio is asserted on real signals, not mocks: artifact/src/test/offline.ts renders through node-web-audio-api and artifact/src/audio/render-stage3.test.ts asserts organ/synth spectra, envelope shapes and morph interpolation; artifact/src/audio/stage3-engine.test.ts:145 asserts crossfade widths blend instead of switching hard.

Required-control coverage is explicit: artifact/src/state/bindings-audit.test.ts walks the hardware model so a new control cannot ship inert, artifact/src/components/decorative-controls.test.tsx pins the excluded set, and artifact/tests/feature-matrix.json maps features to phases.

Two real browser verification scripts exist and pass when run: artifact/scripts/verify-browser-stage3.mjs printed '21/21 browser checks passed' in my environment with concrete measurements (e.g. 'drawbar-brightens high-band ratio 0.0000 → 0.2495'), so the claimed evidence in artifact/evidence/stage3-visual-audit.md is reproducible rather than transcribed.

Shortfalls: no test covers the composition root, which is why the localStorage persistence claim in artifact/IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json:73 went unnoticed; the verification scripts are not wired into package.json scripts and silently require a preview server on port 4622; and the two largest modules carry most of the logic.

criteria.label: Runtime performance
evidence: No console errors on load or during an extended interactive session (hundreds of control interactions, program browsing, split/scene/morph edits and note bursts); both browser scripts independently report 'console-clean no console errors'.
Voice lifecycle is disciplined: active voices returned to 0 and the bus settled to 0.00000 after rapid note bursts, and Panic silences immediately (rms 0.0000) without leaving nodes running.

Render stability held while dragging knobs and browsing programs — aria-valuenow and OLED lines tracked each step with no dropped frames visible in measurement loops (analyser sampling at requestAnimationFrame kept up).
Single-context routing keeps audio load bounded (one AudioContext, destConnects=1) and effect bypass uses ramped crossfades rather than node teardown.

Limits: measured peak 1.038 on a dense layered chord means the master path can clip without user error, and the app rebuilds no state across reload, so a heavy session is discarded rather than persisted.

issues.summary: Program and Live-slot persistence is claimed but not wired in the shipped app.
issues.evidence: artifact/IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json:73 states 'persistence uses localStorage through an injectable storage boundary', and inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.programs.json requires 'Live slots persist edits automatically and survive reload'. In the built app I enabled Live Mode, set piano A level 100 → 60, and reloaded: the app returned to '1.1 Royal Grand' at level 100 with Live Mode off, and Object.keys(localStorage) was [] both before and after reload. artifact/src/App.tsx:64 constructs 'new InstrumentStore()' with no storage argument, and the exported localProgramStorage (artifact/src/state/instrument.ts:591) is referenced nowhere else in src.

issues.summary: Panel section widths follow the visual spec's retired coarse fractions.
issues.evidence: Measured at 1440x900: performance 0.126, organ 0.204, piano 0.146, program 0.087, synth 0.204, effects 0.204. inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.visual.json requires 0.14 / 0.20 / 0.085 / 0.125 / 0.25 / 0.20 and explicitly notes the older piano 0.15 / program 0.09 / synth 0.21 values were corrected because they 'contradicted the photo'. Piano is roughly 1.7x too wide at the expense of program and synth.

issues.summary: Narrow viewports scale the chassis uniformly until labels stop being legible.
issues.evidence: At a 600px-wide viewport the whole instrument shrinks as one unit; synth and effects legends render below ~5px and cannot be read, though geometry, inventory and interaction remain intact.

issues.summary: KB ZONE stepping permits ranges beyond the active split points, silencing the layer with no feedback.
issues.evidence: With only the mid split point active I stepped piano A to 'Piano A zones 2–4'; every probed key (48, 52, 55, 59, 62, 72) measured 0.0 rms. Returning to 'zones 2–2' or 'zones 1–4' restored sound, so the range itself is unreachable rather than broken audio.

issues.summary: Master path can exceed full scale under dense layering.
issues.evidence: Measured peak 1.038 on a layered chord with drive and unison engaged, with Master Level at its default, i.e. no headroom margin before clipping.

issues.summary: Two very large modules and unwired verification scripts.
issues.evidence: artifact/src/audio/engine.ts is 1898 lines covering piano/organ/synth orchestration, pedals, arp, morphs and split gain; artifact/src/state/instrument.ts is comparably large. artifact/scripts/verify-browser*.mjs are not exposed as package.json scripts and fail with ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED unless a preview server is started on port 4622 first.
